what: The skill with its method texts in English, on the second question, measured under the convention of 2026-11-14-methods-default-vs-library-side-income.json: the same plain-asking run (293 ideas, 21 mechanisms), the new skill run merged into two fresh copies of it and grouped twice by Opus, every skill-only mechanism judged twice by the same judge model as before.

setup.seed: the same seed as the earlier default run
setup.methods: the four default methods, English texts with the same meaning as the earlier Chinese texts
setup.grouping_example: the one Chinese example in the grouping prompt replaced by an English one
setup.idea_language: every idea of the run was written in Chinese, as before

audit.judge: the same Claude model as the 2026-11-14 audits (other than Sonnet and Opus); two separate passes over each prompt

reading: Every count of this run is below the earlier run with Chinese texts: 47 and 62 skill-only mechanisms by the grouper against 76 and 74; 33 to 39 left after the judge against 46 to 62.
There is one run on each side. How much two runs with the same texts differ was never measured, so this does not show that the English texts are worse.
The two Opus groupings agreed on fewer ideas than before (85% against 96%); the judge was steadier than before (42 of 47 and 58 of 62 the same in two passes).
limits: one skill run with English texts
two groupings and two judge passes per grouping
one idea of grouping english-opus-2 was left ungrouped and counts as its own mechanism
generation, grouping and judging all used models of one family
